versions.changelog:
- Initial release of eval-rubric-designer skill.
- Generates a complete, weighted rubric with 1–5 concrete anchors for each dimension to evaluate AI outputs.
- Produces a ready-to-run LLM-as-judge prompt with strict JSON output, a labelling guide, and judge reliability notes.
- Guides users in inferring task details and samples to calibrate rubrics when information is missing.
- Built-in quality checks and anti-patterns to ensure actionable, reproducible evaluation.
